{{Quote|Captain Kael! Are you all right, sir?|Lieutenant Gavyn Sykes|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
The '''search''' for [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]] was initiated during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The [[Naboo Resistance]] had joined forces with [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] operating out of the mountains, and together they planned an [[Attack on disabled base|offensive]] against the invading [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] forces. One of their victories was an [[Liberation of enslavement camps|infiltration]] of a Trade Federation [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] camp using a captured [[Ostracoda-class gunboat|gunboat]] to free [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] civilians. After the mission was over, Borvo supplied [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|transports]] while [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] of the resistance escorted the remaining civilians. As Sykes reached the rendezvous, the rest of his [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] told him his flight lead, Captain Kael, had been shot down, and Sykes raced off to find him. During the search, Sykes fought against Federation [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]] and [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]]. He reached a [[plasma mining camp]] and saved it from attacking [[Tank/Legends|tanks]], but the [[Unidentified mine operator|mine's operator]] betrayed him, forcing Sykes to destroy the camp. One of Sykes' [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]], [[Lutin Hollis/Legends|Lutin Hollis]], then contacted Sykes to tell him he had found the Captain. Sykes fought through more Federation forces before reaching Kael, who, with his [[Death/Legends|dying]] breath, revealed that Borvo had betrayed him and asked Sykes to rescue the civilians.

==Prelude==
After joining with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and his [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|organization]] during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]] launched an [[Attack on disabled base|offensive]] against the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. Upon the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Liberation of enslavement camps|liberating]] captured civilians from the Trade Federation, Borvo supplied [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|transports]] for the squadron to pick up the civilians, though [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] was forced to escort a separate group. At the rendezvous, Sykes was joined by his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmates]], who told him that his flight leader, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]], had been shot down, and they then raced off to find him.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==The search==
===On the hunt===
{{Quote|Lieutenant Sykes, I've located the captain's starfighter. It, it doesn't look good.|Lutin Hollis|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
Approaching Kael's last known position, Bravo Squadron split up to search for him. Sykes traveled in his [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|''Seraph''-class urban landspeeder]] to look for him on the ground and was forced to destroy many Federation [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] riding on [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]], who were also searching for Kael. Two [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] blocked Sykes' path on a bridge, but he destroyed them and continued on.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

===Mining camp===
[[File:BFN_mining_camp_attack.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Sykes engages the tanks at the mining camp.]]
{{Quote|This base is programmed to defend itself. This is your last warning.''"<br />"''Not until I get some answers.|The mine operator and Gavyn Sykes|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
After passing the bridge, Sykes saw what he thought was [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|Borvo's personal transport]], but the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] flew off before he could get close. As Sykes moved on, he found a [[plasma mining camp]] under attack by [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces. He intervened, destroying the [[Tank/Legends|tanks]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

Once the tanks were gone, he contacted the [[Unidentified mine operator|mine director]] and asked for information about Captain Kael. The director told Sykes to back off, saying he was running a legal operation. When Sykes refused to comply with the director's warning, the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] camp's remaining [[Laser cannon/Legends|defenses]] opened fire on him, and he was forced to destroy the camp administration building. Sykes had then no choice but to disable the rest of the camp, knocking out the turrets and the camp's [[plasma miner]]s. When the defenses were destroyed, [[Lutin Hollis/Legends|Lutin Hollis]], one of Sykes' wingmen, contacted him, saying he had discovered the Captain's fighter. Sykes saw them on his [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and went to that position.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

===The Captain's fighter===
[[File:BFN_Search01.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Captain Kael's downed starfighter, with Gavyn Sykes in a speeder, and Vedd Deviss and Lutin Hollis in their respective starfighters]]
{{Quote|Sykes. The Hutt be&hellip;trayed us.''"<br />"''And the rescued prisoners?''"<br />"''He'll use them&hellip;as slaves. Rescue them. Good luck. Ah.|Captain Kael's last words|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
The Trade Federation was still looking for Kael, and Sykes had to fight through more Single Trooper Aerial Platforms and two more Armored Assault Tanks. He also noticed [[Trade Federation droid bomber|droid bombers]], and he had to shoot them down before they could find the Captain. After the [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] were down, the rest of the Federation forces retreated, allowing Sykes to approach the Captain. Kael was mortally wounded, and he used his final moments to warn Sykes about the Hutt's betrayal. Sykes asked about the civilians he had rescued; Kael replied Borvo would sell them as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. With his last breath, he ordered Sykes to rescue them.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Vedd, I'll need my N-1 again. We're going after the Hutt.|Gavyn Sykes|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
As the rest of Bravo Squadron arrived, an angry Sykes asked his other wingman, [[Vedd Deviss]], for his [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], saying they were going after Borvo, who was based on [[Porso Hill]]. Bravo Squadron then went on to [[Attack on Porso Hill|avenge]] Kael's [[Death/Legends|death]] and liberate the civilians again.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> The incident was later mentioned in a report given to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] by the leader of the invasion, [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]].<ref name="EG">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Strange. That energy field strengthened my shields.|Gavyn Sykes, if the player passes through the field|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
The search for Captain Kael appears in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. Players assume the role of Gavyn Sykes and pilot a ''Seraph''-class speeder, or "Flash" speeder, as the mission's default craft. The camp's central hub has a spot where the player may go to recharge their [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], and Sykes comments on the effect if the player passes through.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
